title: Ultraman: Hikari no Kyojin Densetsu
native_title: ウルトラマン ～光の巨人伝説～
overview:
Humanity's greatest crisis!!
At that moment, the Giant of Light appears!

The Ultra Brothers take on an army of monsters in this one-on-one fighting game. Battles rage across 3D polygon stages, with city buildings crumbling around the giant combatants as they clash, recreating the excitement of the TV series.

- Fighters include Ultraman, Ultraseven, Ultraman Jack, Ultraman Ace and Ultraman Taro
- Monsters and aliens include Gomora, Eleking, Red King, King Joe, Zetton and Alien Baltan
- Battle the computer or a second player
- Packaged with an expansion ROM cartridge

人類最大の危機!!
その時、光の巨人は現れる!
